title: hedyotis chrysotricha
intro: Hedyotis chrysotricha, commonly known as Swertia or Golden Dustflower, is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis chrysotricha are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as swertiamarin and sweroside, may help to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of fever and digestive issues.
